title: Chapter 56: Zerg Troop Upgrade
content:
Chapter 56: Zerg Troop Upgrade

Through Wu Qing's fierce introduction, coupled with his and the insect queen's research on the lord's scepter, he had a certain understanding of the development of this world lord.

The luck accumulated when the lord's scepter is bound to a territory or organizational entity is the basis for protecting the territory and organizational entities from strange influences. This part of the luck lord cannot be used.

Various territories can increase the luck of the territory gathered through construction and development, gathering people's hearts, increasing strength, accumulating wealth, defeating foreign enemies, spreading fame, increasing prestige, etc.

The most effective way to increase luck is to plunder from outside.

Whether it is plundering through war or trading, whether it is material plundering or spiritual plundering, it can quickly increase the luck of the territory.

No creature in this world can gather luck by itself. It gathers luck through the Lord's Scepter. The Lord's Scepter makes luck perceptible and usable to a certain extent.

The existence of the Qi Luck Beads, the currency among the lords, turned Qi Luck into a tradable item, which made Qi Luck truly materialized.

With the support of a complete system, having enough luck really means having the capital to own everything.

Specifically how to trade and what products are available, Wu Qing is somewhat looking forward to the upcoming first transaction.

Wu Qing and Meng had lunch together and then left. They both had a lot of things to deal with and couldn't stay together all the time.

Wu Qing returned to his residence, returned to consciousness, and began to pay attention to and deal with other things.

What he is most concerned about is the one-star Zerg base that has been upgraded and can now hatch one-star Zerg troops.

The core combat unit of the Zerg is the Hydralisk. After this morning's battle, five more one-star Hydralisks were added, bringing the number of naturally upgraded and evolved one-star Hydralisks to eight.

Wu Qing selected a larva and checked the resources required to hatch a one-star hydralisk. The system prompted that it would cost 250 energy points and 150 qi points.

Compared with the starless Hydralisk, this resource consumption is less than 4 times more energy resources and just 6 times more qi resources.

It is approximately equivalent to the resources consumed to hatch a one-star hydralisk, and can hatch 6 starless hydralisks.

Judging from the fact that the combat power of a one-star Hydralisk that evolves through natural upgrades can be equal to 10 starless Hydralisks, it seems that it is very cost-effective to directly hatch a one-star Hydralisk.

But its combat effectiveness alone does not represent its role on the battlefield. This is a very complex issue.

A unit with strong combat power does not necessarily have a greater effect on the battlefield. This must be viewed according to the specific situation.

Just like when attacking Bugbear infantry, a one-star Hydralisk and ten starless Hydralisks can kill him instantly. Their effects seem to be equivalent.

But if it were to attack the Lizardmen light infantry, the one-star Hydralisk would still kill one or two at a time, and the ten starless Hydralisks might be able to kill several with one salvo.

At this time, the battlefield functions of the two sides are different again.

No matter what, Wu Qing wanted to hatch one first and take a look.

When the hatched one-star hydralisk stood in front of Wu Qing, he noticed something abnormal.

The one-star hydralis that was directly hatched had only the golden star that Wu Qing could see. The color was very light, which was different from the normal gold star of the one-star hydralis that naturally upgraded and evolved.

"This means that the one-star troops that are directly hatched are not as strong as the one-star troops that naturally upgrade and evolve?"

Seeing the difference in color of Venus, Wu Qing thought of the difference in strength.

Wu Qing asked this one-star hydralisk to test its strength. As expected, it was weaker than the naturally upgraded one-star hydralisk in terms of attack power, attack speed and attack distance. The defense was not tested, but he could directly feel that this one Hydralisks are a bit weaker.

"Those who have been tempered by actual combat are stronger. This is very reasonable!"

Wu Qing communicated with the Insect Queen and learned that these one-star hydralisks will improve in strength after being trained in actual combat, and the color of Venus will become normal by then.

Wu Qing still needs to think carefully about whether to hatch a large number of one-star hydralisks.

The next thing Wu Qing inspected was a one-star puppy. The system prompted that he could hatch a one-star puppy by spending 150 energy points and 80 qi points.

Unlike starless puppies, one larva can only hatch a one-star puppy, and no more twin puppies can be hatched.

It is difficult to compare the resource consumption of puppies, but the one-star puppy requires qi resources, and it also consumes 80 points, so Wu Qing's idea of wanting to attack the one-star dog sea can only be temporarily shelved.

However, one-star creatures need to consume qi, which is the luck of this world. This is understandable. After all, the improvement of the strength of this world cannot be separated from this luck.

One-star puppy, Wu Qing also hatched one.

The appearance of the one-star puppy has not changed, and its size has increased to over three meters. The increase in its combat power can be seen with the naked eye.

After testing, it was very easy for the one-star puppy to fight alone and beat ten starless puppies in a row. However, when ten starless puppies attacked the one-star puppy at the same time, the one-star puppy could not resist it.

The results of this test are the same as those of the Hydralisk, which is rather embarrassing. It has indeed become a lot stronger, but it cannot withstand the siege.

This shows that the effect of one star difference on the battlefield is not as big as Wu Qing imagined, unless the number is also increased.

Wu Qing continued to select a larva, this time looking at the one-star host.

Incubating a one-star host consumes the most resources, requiring 300 energy points and 200 qi points.

When Wu Qing saw the extra ability of the one-star host, his eyes lit up and he immediately chose to hatch a one-star host.

The new ability of the one-star host is the control center. With this ability, it can connect other ordinary hosts and greatly increase the population limit of the Zerg.

This solves the problem of too little population limit of the Zerg provided by one host for Wu Qing.

In order to support such a large population of Zerg, the sky above the Zerg territory is now full of hosts, and there are also a large number of hosts above the Daxia territory. It all depends on the host's talent to reduce the sense of presence, so that the surrounding creatures rarely notice their existence.

This number of nearly a thousand hosts not only easily exposes the location of the Zerg territory, but also consumes a lot of resources.

Now, only a small number of one-star hosts are needed to connect all hosts, and the population limit of the Zerg will no longer be restricted.

Because the one-star host has no ability to upgrade transportation, the size of the body does not change much, and the mental strength, defense ability and movement speed are all enhanced.

The last one-star unit that can be hatched is the worker bee. The one-star worker bee consumes 150 energy and 50 gas, which is slightly less than the consumption of the one-star puppy.

Wu Qing hatched one, and the size of the one-star worker bee became a little bigger, and the work efficiency was greatly improved.

After checking all the one-star Zerg troops, Wu Qing decided to upgrade some one-star hosts first to solve the population limit problem.

Wu Qing found that the hatched no-star troops could also be upgraded to one star by making up the resource price difference, and their corresponding combat experience would be retained.

Wu Qing felt that this was better than directly hatching with larvae.

Wu Qing was not going to upgrade other Zerg troops for the time being. How to upgrade and how many to upgrade required careful consideration and actual combat verification.
